entity_raw.definition_raw:
Faint vibrations in stone can alert you to trouble.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (dungeoneering) 4 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +3 bonus on Perception checks in underground or mountainous environments. If you have 10 or more ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering), this bonus increases to + 6.
